answer: The most enriched process in ASXL1-mutated fibroblasts is the **potassium calcium-activated channel subfamily** (KCNMB1, KCNMB4, KCNMB3, KCNMA1, KCNMB2): it is the #1-ranked family by GSEA-style preranked enrichment of the full protein-coding DE list (NES 2.11, permutation p=0.001, BH FDR=0.043), up-regulated in ASXL1-mutated vs control, and it is independently the top ORA hit (2/5 family members DE-up, 23.3-fold over-representation). DE context: 564 genes were differentially expressed at FDR<0.05 (416 up / 148 down) out of 16,203 protein-coding genes tested (NB-GLM Wald, condition+sex); leading DE genes include CNTN4, UGT3A2, TBX20, GNAO1 (up) and PSG4, STMN2, GREM2 (down). Caveat: HGNC gene-family enrichment used as an offline proxy for biological-process enrichment; official GO BP could not be executed because no gene-set ontology source exists in the sandbox and the network is unreachable.
